set.body: From review of S4.5c (branch p0-s45c). GroupMeans/ParticipantSummary carry a single d with no scale identity, so ParticipantMeans infers the scale by exact float equality with GroupSummary.dByScale. That refuses the right scale when the summation paths differ and accepts the wrong one when means coincide across scales. Acceptance: the summary declares a meansScale: ScaleIndex (or carries per-scale means); ParticipantMeans compares indices and the float heuristic is removed, with a test that equal values at two scales do not confuse the label.
set.title: ResultSummary declares the scale of its group/participant means
